description: Show which npm packages and app code dominate the shared chunks loaded by many routes, to identify what bloats common bundles. Each package reports its unminified webpack module size, its share of the chunk's module bytes, and that share applied to the chunk's emitted size. Requires load_build_stats and load_webpack_stats first.

limit.description: Maximum shared chunks to analyse. Defaults to 5.

name: explain_shared_chunks
title: Explain Shared Chunks
